bagPolicy.summary: Each guest may bring one bag no bigger than A4; rucksacks and larger bags are prohibited and all bags are checked. The on-site cloakroom is for permitted small items, not large bags.
allowed: One bag up to A4 size
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: There are two accessible bays outside the front of the venue on Stockwell Road. The operator’s travel guide does not promise regular show parking.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The academy’s FAQ and venue arrival pages do not designate a rideshare pickup site.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Cashless bars sell drinks and snack food, with free drinking water. Outside food, drinks and chewing gum are prohibited; contact the venue beforehand about health needs.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Two accessible parking bays are on Stockwell Road; accessible tickets can be booked online, and the venue publishes detailed access advice.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue FAQ covers a designated outdoor smoking area but does not publish a universal rule for leaving and re-entering the site.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are held in the O2 Academy Venues app and each group member needs their own ticket. If a ticket cannot be found, ask the ticket-resolution team in the queue; the box office is accessible only once inside.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Check the event page and ticket for door and curfew times; security checks bags in the arrival queue.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
